title: Optimization of carbazole carboxamide RORgammat agonists: Challenges in improving the metabolic stability and maintaining the agonistic activity.
authors: Sun, Nannan; Yu, Mingcheng; Jiang, Zhengyuan; Yang, Feng; Lu, Lixue; Xia, Yuehan; Zhao, Yunpeng; Huang, Yafei; Chen, Song; Chen, Shijie; Luo, Cheng; Wang, Yonghui; Xie, Qiong
one_liner_zh: 该文为RORgammat小分子激动剂的药物化学优化研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Based on two previously discovered carbazole carboxamide retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor-gammat (RORgammat) agonists 6 and 7 (t(1/2) = 8.7 min and 16.4 min in mouse liver microsome, respectively), new carbazole carboxamides were designed and synthesized according to the molecular mechanism of action (MOA) and metabolic site analysis with the aim of identifying novel RORgammat agonists with optimal pharmacological and metabolic profiles. By modifying the "agonist lock" touching substitutions on carbazole ring, introducing heteroatoms into different parts of the molecule and attaching a side chain to the sulfonyl benzyl moiety, several potent RORgammat agonists were identified with greatly improved metabolic stability. Best overall properties were achieved in compound (R)-10f with high agonistic activities in RORgammat dual FRET (EC(50) = 15.6 nM) and Gal4 reporter gene (EC(50) = 141 nM) assays and greatly improved metabolic stability (t(1/2) > 145 min) in mouse liver microsome. Besides, the binding modes of (R)-10f and (S)-10f in RORgammat ligand binding domain (LBD) were also studied. Altogether, the optimization of carbazole carboxamides led to the discovery of (R)-10f as a potential small molecule therapeutics for cancer immunotherapy.
abstract_zh: 基于先前发现的两个咔唑甲酰胺维A酸受体相关孤儿受体γt（RORγt）激动剂6和7（在小鼠肝微粒体中t(1/2)分别为8.7分钟和16.4分钟），根据作用分子机制（MOA）和代谢位点分析，设计并合成了新的咔唑甲酰胺类化合物，旨在发现具有最佳药理学和代谢特性的新型RORγt激动剂。通过修饰咔唑环上触及“激动剂锁”的取代基、在分子不同部位引入杂原子以及在磺酰苄基部分连接侧链，鉴定出几种代谢稳定性显著提高的有效RORγt激动剂。化合物(R)-10f在RORγt双FRET（EC(50) = 15.6 nM）和Gal4报告基因（EC(50) = 141 nM）实验中表现出高激动活性，并在小鼠肝微粒体中代谢稳定性大幅改善（t(1/2) > 145分钟），综合性能最佳。此外，还研究了(R)-10f和(S)-10f在RORγt配体结合域（LBD）中的结合模式。总体而言，咔唑甲酰胺的优化促成了(R)-10f作为癌症免疫治疗潜在小分子药物的发现。
